network: enabled; user proxy settings preserved; web_search live

measurement_corrections.swap_whole_genre_columns: 栏目定位不应要求恰好四个条目；模型误把Matinee移组是另一项问题。按类别标题识别列，交换实际正确。
measurement_corrections.first_second_swap_reverted: 原生details需要先打开；打开后的四条菜单恢复原序，不能因button定位器不识别summary而扣分。
measurement_corrections.fine_dining_panel: 接受原生details/summary和装饰图标前缀。
measurement_corrections.lounge_panel: 接受原生details/summary和装饰图标前缀。
measurement_corrections.faq_expand: 接受原生details/summary，不要求角色为自定义button。
measurement_corrections.archive_preview_switch: 按钮有装饰图标前缀，使用非前缀锚定名称定位；真实图片和文字切换已核对。

conservative_exclusions.bebop_dark_blue_only: 原始指针在类别标题及其背景之间移动，标题先深蓝后金色的解读存在合理分歧；不以此项压低主分。
conservative_exclusions.both_column_borders_gold: 原视频指针集中经过两栏标题附近，标题与外框的目标层级有争议；两种解读差异不计主分。
conservative_exclusions.hide_feel_button_body_only: Hide all of these可以被理解成隐藏完整Feel入口或仅描述；此项不作为主分失败依据。
conservative_exclusions.second_chorus_larger_bold_smaller_body: 两次字号指代跨越折叠展开与指针移动，First/Second以及标题/正文的精确目标有争议；保守排除此项。
conservative_exclusions.artist_description_time_bindings: 原型截图中时段位于卡片裁切区域之外，无法要求保留材料未显示的时间。演出名称完整性仍由独立项目检查。

asr_note: Large-v3 transcription calls returned resource errors; model independently retried with small and completed both transcripts. No interrupted run or API failure was scored zero.
limits: One run; outcome score is not official EFS or a calibrated cross-case difficulty ranking. Visual fidelity is partly checked by preserved content/layout and paired screenshots, not a separate pixel/VLM judge. Task-only file access is instruction enforced, not OS isolation; command scan is not a mathematical proof of no leakage.
